posts.title: Building NotMyCMS - A Lightweight Git-Backed CMS with AWS and Kiro
posts.description: Why I built my own CMS for this site and how it works - a static site on S3 and CloudFront, a serverless admin, and content kept as Markdown in git so version history and rollback come for free.

posts.title: Building Logstead - A Schedule E Rental Tax App with AWS and Kiro
posts.description: How I built Logstead, a focused serverless web app for preparing an IRS Schedule E rental tax return, on AWS with Kiro - year-end totals, straight-line depreciation, and per-property reports.

posts.title: Building a Personal AWS VPN with WireGuard and Kiro
posts.description: Build a secure, config-driven personal VPN on AWS using WireGuard, CDK Python, and a Makefile, cheaper than a subscription with full control over your infrastructure.
